newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-CURRIE CUP FINAL ROUND RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CURRIE CUP FINAL ROUND RESULTS.

text.p: Results from the final round
of Currie Cup rugby union matches played on Saturday:
In Pietersberg: (match played on Friday night): Northern
Transvaal beat South Western Districts 147-8 (halftime 78-8).
Scorers:
Northern Transvaal - Tries: Jacques Olivier (7), Andre
Snyman (3), Lance Sherrell (2), Joost van der Westhuizen (2),
Schutte Bekker (2), Hannes Venter (2), Kobus Engelbrecht, F.A.
Meiring, Louwrens Campher, Conrad Breytenbach, Willie Enslin.
Conversios: Lance Sherrell (14), Kobus Engelbrecht (2).
South Western Districts - Try: Paul Treu. Penalty: Jurie
Coetzee.
In Bloemfontein (match played on Friday night): Free State
beat Northern Free State 54-17 (halftime 19-17).
Scorers:
Free State - Tries: Naka Drotske (3), Chris Badenhorst (2),
Johan Erasmus, Kat Myburgh. Conversions-M.J.Smith (2).
Penalties: M.J.Smith (5).
Northern Free State - Tries: Albertus van Buuren, Willie
Nagel. Conversions: Eric Herbert (2). Penalty: Herbert.
In Potchefstroom: Eastern Province beat Western Transvaal
34-25 (halftime 3-22).
Scorers:
Western Transvaal - Try: Tony Lincoln. Conversion: Dewald
Basson. Penalties: Basson (6).
Eastern Province - Tries: Bertus Kruger (2), Ronnie Fourie.
Conversions: Kruger (2). Penalties: Kruger (5).
In Cape Town: Western Province beat Griquas 30-16 (halftime
Scorers:
Western Province - Tries: Toks van der Linde, Hottie Louw,
Conversion: Louis Koen. Penalties: Louis Koen (6)
Griqualand West - Try: Abrie Pretorius. Conversion: Franco
Smith. Penalties: Franco Smith (2), Edrich Lubbe
In Wellington: Transvaal beat Boland 30-24 (halftime 15-7).
Scorers:
Boland - Tries: Harold Karele, Stefan Terblanche, Marius
Goosen. Conversions: Francois Horn (3). Penalties: Horn.
Transvaal - Tries: Pieter Hendriks (2), Joe Gillingham,
penalty try. Conversions: Gavin Lawless (2). Penalties: Lawless
In East London: Natal beat Border 54-18 (halftime 21-18).
Scorers:
Border - Tries: Glenn Gelderbloom, Anton Botha, Conversions:
Greg Miller. Penalties: Miller (2)
Natal - Tries: Wickus van Heerden, John Slade (2), Walter
Minaar, John Allan, Frederico Mendez, John Plumtree, Errol
Stewart. Conversions: Thierry Lacroix (7)
